math_review.input: Exactly11 unique canonical sectors, finite nonnegative JSON numeric weights and positive exact sum.
math_review.normalization: Fractions w_i/sum(w) retain exact relative ratios before rounding.
math_review.rounding: Exact quotas sum10000. Floors sum at most10000; their integer deficit is nonnegative and less than11. Adding1 to the largest fractional remainders in fixed sector-code tie order yields exactly10000 nonnegative integer units.
math_review.representation: Integer units over10000 are authoritative; formatted weights have4decimal places and percentages2decimal places. The final integer sum therefore equals100.00% exactly.
math_review.bound_diagnostics: Compare raw, exact normalized and integer final weights to valid submitted min/max bounds without enforcement. Do not treat finalization as a constrained optimizer or source validation.
math_review.resource_policy: Coefficient digits, absolute exponent and adjusted exponent bounded at512; input length bounded at2M characters. Out-of-range weights are unavailable and are never clipped.

resolved_findings.resolution: Constraint ID must be nonempty unique string; malformed identity/bound/evidence becomes unassessable; only typed safe fields copied.
Bounds require finite bounded Decimal in[0,1], with explicit source-support unchecked statement.
Integer attempt type, integrity/continuation/preservation/accounting and exact reviewed response envelope/refs required.
Stage mode rejects output throughout containing raw run tree.
Exact case/stage order, stage status/count and observed directories, aggregate attempts and postread summary hash required.
Decimal resource limits checked before every input Fraction conversion; DecimalException explicitly handled.
Full JSON ensure_ascii=True serialization and UTF-8 encode complete before exclusive binary file open.

failure_state_policy.invalid_model_vector: Return unavailable with reason; no missing/negative sectors are invented or clipped.
failure_state_policy.invalid_submitted_constraint: Preserve valid arithmetic result and report constraint unassessable; no semantic enforcement or repair.
failure_state_policy.ordinary_declared_failed_or_unattempted_: Retain unavailable slot in valid terminal report; five planned finals and ten slots remain denominators.
failure_state_policy.corrupt_or_missing_declared_artifact: Fail closed by raising before CLI output creation; no misleading finalized report or reduced denominator is emitted. Existing raw terminal summary remains the independent denominator evidence.
failure_state_policy.unexpected_internal_arithmetic_invariant: Raises; does not silently substitute a result.

Corrupt/missing declared artifacts intentionally produce no derived report; downstream automation must surface nonzero failure and retain raw denominator evidence.
